title: LLM applications y RAG con evidencia

continuity_gate.S02-S47: dedicated section JSONs present on audit branch

findings.issue: S48 requires S47, but S47 remains REPAIR_REQUIRED with a P0.
Canonical estimatedHours is 9 while the live card shows 20h.
The section promises every assertion is supported, while executable gates never test semantic support between claim text and source text.
The contract promises immunity to injected instructions but only supplies an injected_instruction_ignored boolean.
T1-A says embedding version, normalization and metric are index-contract fields but code validates none of them.
Vector comparison silently accepts incompatible dimensions and zero vectors.
Cosine and dot are mixed without normalization or explaining when rankings are equivalent.
The holdout is only a name/prefix, not a qrels/evaluation artifact bound to index revision and metric.
Impossible recall/cost values can promote.
Missing reindex cost routes to EVALUATE_ERROR_SLICES, which does not address the missing evidence.
T1-A and T1-B figures teach later provenance/ACL constructs rather than current embedding/evaluation constructs.
Semantic-unit chunking is framed too categorically instead of as an evaluated retrieval design choice.
T2-A prose requires provenance-aware hash, while code hashes only text and omits source_version.
SHA-256 is truncated to 12 hex chars and used as stable identity without qualification.
T2-A practice checks supplied hash uniqueness rather than constructing provenance-aware identities.
Deletion cache invalidation and provenance are claimed but not executed.
ACL-before-rank is not composed with an actual ranking stage in the executable demo.
Raw dense and lexical scores are linearly combined without normalization/calibration.
Reranking is promised but not implemented.
ACL is absent from the hybrid/rerank executable path.
Multi-query holdout Recall@k is promised but practice mostly validates one expected top.
Hybrid weights and k are not domain-validated.
Core grounded/cited gate does not verify that cited text actually supports the claim.
Authorization/resolution of all citations is collapsed into one caller-supplied boolean.
Indirect prompt-injection resistance is self-attested by a boolean instead of observed behavior.
Structured-output field changes from claim to answer without an explained schema migration.
Answer quality/groundedness is self-attested through scalar/boolean inputs rather than computed from response/context eval data.
Cost is not consistently defined or measured.
support changes from numeric score to boolean without explaining thresholding.
Evaluation/cost domains are not validated.
All 24 exercises heavily reuse the same inverted-predicate / valid-invalid-missing / route-token grammar.
E3 is labeled transfer but usually preserves the same case, schema, predicate and output vocabulary.
Missing-first routing can hide an already-observable breach in every E3 family.
You Do can become READY by flipping four booleans while retrieve() and answer() remain NotImplemented stubs.
S48 invents CP-N4-C-RAG although the roadmap says S48 starts CP-N4-C and S51 closes it.
You Do requires REQUEST_CLARIFICATION although no S48 subtopic defines that action.
Final project does not require execution of indirect-injection behavior or claim-level support relation.
Commands, pinned dependencies, expected output, risk owner, rollback criterion and limitations are required in prose but ignored by readiness.
Rubric assigns 15% to SLO/observability/rollback although S48 does not operationalize those constructs or import prior evidence.
Four roadmap-mandated authentic topic evaluations are absent.
Fallback self-check has 7 questions rather than exactly one per 8 subtopics.
All 24 authenticated S48 exam variants use correctIndex 1 (option B), so all-B answers yield 100%.
Many authenticated-exam distractors are absurd/off-construct and weakly diagnostic.
Editorial/audit-process phrasing leaked into learner-facing callouts.
Dense English/Spanglish terminology is not consistently anchored to plain Spanish on first use.
Resources are broad/partly legacy and miss direct current references for the highest-risk RAG contracts.

rejected_findings: Do not rename ai-governance without migration.
Do not require paid/external LLM or public cloud.
S48 figures are present; placement is the issue.
Dot product is not inherently wrong; normalization/equivalence conditions matter.
Semantic chunking is not inherently wrong; benchmark it.
S50 owns systematic red-team coverage; S48 only needs evidence for its narrower claim.
Authenticated S48 bank exists with 8 concepts x 3 variants; the all-B key is the defect.
No evidence of an ai-governance stale playground mapping in SectionView.
fixer_invariants: A material claim passes only when claim text is supported by resolved active authorized evidence text, not merely because an ID is present.
READY is derived from executed evidence receipts; learner-controlled booleans and NotImplemented stubs cannot satisfy the project gate.
Authenticated exam keys must not have a predictable answer-position pattern; CI checks distribution and one-per-subtopic coverage.
Embedding ranking validates dimensions, finite values, metric, normalization and model/index version.
Baseline/candidate retrieval evaluation binds to versioned queries/qrels/index revision and valid metric domains.
Chunk identity separates content fingerprint from provenance-aware versioned identity.
ACL/deletion/cache/provenance are executed state transitions and precede every rank/rerank stage.
Hybrid fusion normalizes/calibrates heterogeneous scores or uses rank fusion; reranking is a distinct practiced operation.
Known breach is never hidden by unrelated missing evidence.
S48 is an increment toward CP-N4-C; CP-N4-C closes at S51.
artifact_note: Full 124-element paragraph/exercise-level ledger is the current-conversation artifact S48.json; this repository file is the durable continuity manifest bound to its SHA-256.
